label: PREMIER LEAGUE · SATURDAY
headline: Brighton win at the Etihad
sub: Yasin Ayari scored on 11 minutes. City had 21 shots and couldn't find an equaliser.
caption:
😱 Brighton beat Man City 1–0 at the Etihad. Yasin Ayari's 11th-minute goal was enough, despite City taking 21 shots.

City stay on 21 points, so Arsenal can go top with a win at Anfield on Sunday.

Big blow to City's title hopes? 👇
